data.body:
STATUS (2026-08-31 ~15:45 PDT) — overnight stability-analysis session (background job), pausing at a checkpoint.

DELIVERABLES so far, all under .scratch/stability-analysis/ (git-ignored):
- Evidence: 01 ticket-store mining, 02(+a,b) git/Gerrit mining, 03 prior-RCA synthesis (65-row ledger over .joe-janitor/, session-logs/, 104 ADRs), 04 codebase/test-suite audit (incl. 2 identical full-suite runs: determinism is fine on this host; fragility is CHANGE fragility).
- 05 diagnosis v2 (revised after adversarial review 05b): M1 shared-checkout store under parallel writers; M2 attestation currency (empty-scope fallback to whole-HEAD) + over-gating; M3 tests bound to internals (2,772 setattr on own modules; 23x peer monkeypatch density; ~30% of suite tests the process); M4 additive-only remediation (zero reverts; defensive mechanisms grew 2-12x code); M5 landing hole (79% of Aug merges = submit-time rebase no CI executed; main has no per-commit CI since 08-05); M6 process mass/decision velocity/single operator; M7 (operator hypothesis, partially confirmed by measurement): 17% of Aug-5+ bugs are speculative-only (no executed evidence; close as preexisting 45%/plan_defect 26%), 13% sibling-sweep-framed — imagined risks -> real guards -> real bugs.
- 06 plan v2 (two prongs) after two max-effort critics (06b acute, 06c chronic), three experiments (E1 store prototype: flock+CAS validated, pure CAS refuted; E2 landing/gate yield: 19/48 criteria zero-block, P6 pure noise, completion-verifier "FP" proxy invalid, 2-lane batch queue sizing; E3 incomplete) and three cross-model reviews (GPT-5.6 X1, gpt-oss-120b X2, DeepSeek X3). Key v2 shape: Day-0 re-baseline (enrich drain already off 08-28; K2 ~12K/wk; race merges 11-13%), close-sweep not supersede for the 9 merged in-progress tickets, flock+CAS for _seam.append_event ONLY (ends PASS-but-unsigned; txn/compaction = Program 2), unscoped-plan DET block replaces stale-head fallback, criteria posture from measured yield (delete P6, demote July-zero-block set incl. T5c/portability, promote T8/E6), completion verifier STAYS blocking (record FAIL material fingerprints first), batch merge queue then Verified copyCondition -> NO_CODE_CHANGE only, per-commit main CI grouped by SHA, harness facade + shrink-only test ratchet, rebar-janitor -> rebar-subtract with D1-D3 deterrent decision rule, rebar-debug ~3K-word skeleton (its lines 676-679 instruct --force — to be deleted), rebar-implement heldout fix. Operator constraints recorded in 06-plan 0c: no time-horizon freezes; no Claude-specific hooks as enforcement (harness-neutral boundaries only); polyglot-generalizable seams. P11 added: bugs require executed evidence; code-read risks file as task/idea; sweeps file one class ticket.

ACTIONS taken in the tracker/repo: created bug horrendous-limpid-chamois (4eae-c207-7d7b-41f3): enrich PRODUCER still appends ENQUEUE_ENRICH on every certification (attest.py:216-225) while overlap_drain=off — 95 events in 2 days into a dead queue; one subagent dispatched to fix it end-to-end (worktree, plan-review gate, RED-first, Gerrit, close) incl. suggest_duplicate_tickets=false. No other repo/tracker mutations from this session; E3's five probe worktrees removed.

NEXT: fold subagent outcome + finalize executive summary (00-README), decide whether to re-run E3 on a quiet host, then final report to operator. Analysis dir also holds X1-X3 cross-model reviews.
